reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Identified the pte_none_or_zero() function as unnecessary and suggested using additional helpers like pte_is_zero_page() or pte_maps_zero_page().

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This RFC patch proposes adding a new function, pte_none_or_zero(), to the Linux kernel's mm module. The function is designed to determine whether a page table entry (PTE) maps nothing or the shared zero-page. This change aims to simplify code that needs to handle both cases by providing a single helper function.
